50291105.protein: Mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase kinase 4
50291105.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to MAP4K4 (unknown origin) by surface plasmon resonance assay
50291105.references_previous: 9. Hopkins, A. L.; Groom, C. R.; Alex, A. Drug Discovery Today 2004, 9, 430–431. 10. Abad-Zapatero, C. Expert Opin. Drug Discov. 2007, 2, 469–488.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: A screen of 2361 fragments (molecular weight <350 Da) at 100 μM as singletons was carried out using Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) to measure binding to recombinant MAP4K4 kinase domain, which identified 225 confirmed hits after 6-point K_D determination (Fig. 1). The enzyme affinities of the hits had K_D values from 10 to 2010 μM and ligand efficiencies (LE) from 0.30 to 0.67.9,10
original_paragraph.Figure 1 caption: Figure 1. Workflow of SPR fragment screening and hit follow up.
original_paragraph.Table 1 caption: Table 1 MAP4K4 SPR binding affinity of primary amine substitutions and ether replacement
original_paragraph.Table 1 footnote a: All SPR results are reported as the arithmetic mean of at least 2 separate runs. For details on the SPR assay, see Supplementary information.
